mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name, c.category, c.specification, c.unit, c.max_stack AS "maxStack", (SELECT count(*) FROM consumable_lot cl WHERE cl.consumable_id = c.id AND cl.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cl.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "lotCount", (SELECT coalesce(sum(cl.remaining), 0) FROM consumable_lot cl WHERE cl.consumable_id = c.id AND cl.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cl.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "totalRemaining" FROM consumable c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{t} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.category = #{category}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM consumable_lot cl JOIN resource_node dev ON dev.id = cl.device_id AND dev.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id WHERE cl.consumable_id = c.id AND cl.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cl.deleted_at IS NULL AND dev.parent_id = #{islandId})
ORDER BY c.id
SELECT id, code, name, category, specification, unit, max_stack AS "maxStack" FROM consumable WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consumable (tenant_id, code, name, category, specification, unit, max_stack) VALUES (#{t}, #{code}, #{name}, #{category}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{maxStack})
mapper.update: UPDATE consumable SET name = #{name}, category = #{category}, specification = #{specification}, unit = #{unit}, max_stack = #{maxStack}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE consumable SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, consumable_id AS "consumableId", lot_no AS "lotNo", barcode, quantity, remaining, location_id AS "locationId", device_id AS "deviceId", expire_at AS "expireAt", status FROM consumable_lot WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consumable_lot (tenant_id, consumable_id, lot_no, barcode, quantity, remaining, location_id, device_id, expire_at, status) VALUES (#{t}, #{consumableId}, #{lotNo}, #{barcode}, #{quantity}, #{remaining}, #{locationId}, #{deviceId}, #{expireAt}::timestamptz, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE consumable_lot
remaining = #{remaining}, location_id = #{locationId}, device_id = #{deviceId}, expire_at = #{expireAt}::timestamptz, status = #{status}, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE consumable_lot SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE device_point SET point_role = #{pointRole}, robot_reachable = #{robotReachable}, is_entry = #{isEntry}, is_exit = #{isExit}, order_in_device = #{orderInDevice}, -- 编辑弹窗不填备注时不该把已有「装载口」备注冲掉 note = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), note), position_label = CASE WHEN #{positionLabel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN position_label ELSE NULLIF(#{positionLabel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') END, is_standalone = COALESCE(#{isStandalone,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, is_standalone), -- grid_row/grid_col 保持直接赋值：包进 CASE 时 untyped 参数会被 PG 推断成 -- text，赋给 smallint 列会报错。「单独位置清空坐标」放在 Java 层做。 grid_row = #{gridRow}, grid_col = #{gridCol}, max_height_mm = #{maxHeightMm}, plate_types = CASE WHEN #{plateTypes} IS NULL OR #{plateTypes} = '' THEN NULL ELSE string_to_array(#{plateTypes}, ',') END, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND point_resource_id = #{pointResourceId}
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{deviceResourceId} AND kind = 'device'
mapper.insert: WITH rn AS ( INSERT INTO resource_node (tenant_id, code, name, parent_id, kind, location, attr, sort_order) VALUES (#{t}, #{pointCode}, #{pointCode}, #{deviceResourceId}, COALESCE((SELECT r2.kind FROM resource_node r2 WHERE r2.tenant_id = #{t} AND r2.parent_id = #{deviceResourceId} AND r2.kind IN ('incubator','storage') ORDER BY r2.id LIMIT 1), 'storage'), jsonb_build_object('zone', #{deviceCode}, 'point', #{pointCode}), '{"source":"load-port"}'::jsonb, 0) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, code) DO UPDATE SET parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id, updated_at = now() RETURNING id ), dp AS ( INSERT INTO device_point (tenant_id, device_resource_id, point_resource_id, point_role, robot_reachable, is_entry, is_exit, order_in_device, is_standalone, position_label, note) SELECT #{t}, #{deviceResourceId}, rn.id, 'both', true, #{isEntry}, #{isExit}, 0, true, #{positionLabel}, '单独位置（进口/出口，网格外；机械臂装载口）' FROM rn ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, point_resource_id) DO UPDATE SET point_role = 'both', robot_reachable = true, is_entry = EXCLUDED.is_entry, is_exit = EXCLUDED.is_exit, is_standalone = true, position_label = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.position_label, ''), device_point.position_label), grid_row = NULL, grid_col = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING point_resource_id ), ps AS ( INSERT INTO position_state (tenant_id, resource_id, plate_id, updated_at) SELECT #{t}, dp.point_resource_id, NULL, now() FROM dp ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING resource_id ) SELECT id FROM rn
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM consumable_lot WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND consumable_id = #{consumableId} AND lot_no = #{lotNo} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT parent_id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{resourceId} AND parent_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_state (tenant_id, resource_id, plate_id, content_kind, content_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{t}, #{resourceId}, NULL, #{contentKind}, #{contentId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO UPDATE SET plate_id = NULL, content_kind = EXCLUDED.content_kind, content_id = EXCLUDED.content_id, updated_at = now()
